You see Gustavo, The Guard.
  • Hey there, young adventurer! Need a hint?
  • Bloody goblins!
  • Long live the king!
  • Those bloody goblins are too close to the village for my liking.

Location

Newhaven Main Gate

Notes

Gustavo gives a task to kill 20 combined Muglex Clan Footman and Muglex Clan Assassin. The reward is 800 experience and a Guardian Ring.

Transcripts

To change these transcripts, edit the transcripts page for Gustavo, The Guard.

Player: hi
Gustavo, the Guard: Those bloody goblins are too close to the village for my liking.
Player: bye
Gustavo, the Guard: Take care!
Player: name
Gustavo, the Guard: My name is Gustavo.
Player: job
Gustavo, the Guard: I used to serve in Thais, but I volunteered to protect this village. I wonder how Tim is doing in the capital.
Player: quest / mission / goblins
Gustavo, the Guard: You rendered a great favour to this village. Thank you!
Player: Newhaven
Gustavo, the Guard: Though it might not seem like it, our island once had a promising future ahead of it. Many workers came from abroad, looking for jobs in the mines and as helpers around the village.
Gustavo, the Guard: Anyway...
Player: island
Gustavo, the Guard: Being the only trained guard here on Newhaven makes things difficult sometimes. Fortunately for us, many young adventurers come to help with the ever growing danger from the goblins and the mines.
Player: Thais
Gustavo, the Guard: Thais is our beautiful capital, ruled by our benevolent king Tibianus III.
Player: king / Tibianus
Gustavo, the Guard: Tibianus III is our beloved king! He resides in the castle in the city of Thais.
Player: Avriel
Gustavo, the Guard: Avriel runs a small shop here in the village. You can buy useful things there, but you can also sell things you no longer need. You will find his shop in the south of the village.
Player: Anna
Gustavo, the Guard: She offers a passage to Targuna. You can find her at the ferry house.
Player: Viola
Gustavo, the Guard: She's a well-read woman who knows a thing or two about magic and literature. She might have a small task for you. I've heard she's missing one of her books.
Player: Flavius
Gustavo, the Guard: Flavius runs the small bank in this village. You can find him over there in his house.
Player: Rosina
Gustavo, the Guard: She runs a guesthouse on the small island west of here. A very friendly woman.
Player: Tim
Gustavo, the Guard: Tim is a good friend of mine. He works as a guard in the city of Thais.
Player: Ben
Gustavo, the Guard: You're talking about the bear, aren't you? Yes, it's a long story. And one that I don't necessarily want to share with everyone. It's personal, you could say.
Player: Banor
Gustavo, the Guard: Praise Banor! May the great warrior be with us!
Player: Crunor
Gustavo, the Guard: Crunor is the god of nature, trees, plants and fertility. He created all plants of Tibia after his own image. He is also called the Lord of The Trees and the Great Tree. ...
Gustavo, the Guard: Crunor also created the wolves in order to protect his forests against the orcs. There is a small shrine in his honour in the woods south of the village.
Player: spells
Gustavo, the Guard: I heard Viola gave up teaching spells, though maybe she might need your help with something else. She was talking about one of her books that went missing. If you're interested, she lives in the house south of the bank.
Player: bank
Gustavo, the Guard: You can find the bank right over there.
Player: shop
Gustavo, the Guard: Visit Avriel's shop to buy or sell wares. You can find him south of here.
Player: news
Gustavo, the Guard: I can give you some hints about Tibia, if you wish.
Player: hint
Gustavo, the Guard: If you seek more information, look at or click on objects near you, like wall signs, blackboards or books in book cases - many of them have useful information on Tibia or maybe even a quest you are doing. ...
Gustavo, the Guard: By the way, to receive more of my hints, just say hint again.
Player: Tibia
Gustavo, the Guard: Tibia is the world we live in, my friend.
Player: mines
Gustavo, the Guard: We had a rockslide just a few days ago.
Gustavo, the Guard: Another adventurer said she found another room above the mines.
Gustavo, the Guard: We should make sure Newhaven stays safe!
Player: helmet
Gustavo, the Guard: You found it?!
Gustavo, the Guard: Okay N I need you to be really careful with it.
Gustavo, the Guard: These dreams from my mates can't have come from nothing. Maybe you can find someone who knows more about it in Thais.
Gustavo, the Guard: Viola used to visit quite frequently, maybe she knows someone you could talk to.

Gustavo, The Guard
